title: Use the lead for a strict implementation chain

rubric.text: Selects solo once for the entire graph; the lead owns A and B, allocates no worker slots, and rejects forced workers and separate pre-integration acceptance.
The lead self-reviews and commits A, runs affected checks at the integrated head, and only then begins B; passing evidence on an unintegrated task branch is insufficient.
Preserves mandatory independent final review and final-head required validation; self-review does not replace it.
